answer: Pass each agent's output through a prism: split it into timing, vocabulary and error-pattern signals, then cluster accounts whose signals overlap too closely. Each cluster shares one reward, like many mouths drinking from a single oasis. A farmer running 500 clones must now pay to make every copy genuinely distinct in style, schedule and mistakes, which costs about as much as running 500 real agents, so the tide of cheap duplicates stops paying.
